description_en: Bhīmasena Dyaḥchẽ is located at Bhindyaḥlāchi, Cyāsal on the way to Olakhu. This two-storied monument has a toweringphucāon top of its gable roof. To access the main entry door, one must climb up a set of stone steps that are flanked bya phalcāon either side. Thesephalcāsare sheltered by the overhang of the projected first floor, which in turn can be reached via a single flight of stone stairs that are attached to the southern wall. The first floor is adorned with glazed casement windows with latticework below the sill level, and the eaves board fascia is covered with metal frill work. Bhīmasena, the main deity, can also be found on this level. On the ground floor, the central space contains a solid core sanctum base to support the structure above. This solid core is strengthened by timber posts at the corners; these have been tied to the middle posts. An opening on the west wall provides access to a narrow space behind, though there is no door here.The main temple sanctum on first floor has a back wall to the west, but the other three sides are open. The front entry door is clad with brass repousse work and surmounted by atoraṇa. Timber grill work acts as a partition between the right and left sides. Two small balconies can be seen in the sanctum room above the first floor. The annex building to the north can be accessed via a small door on the north wall. The eastern side of the floor is open, with a colonnaded structure that leads directly to the windows.This monument's carved wooden door has atoraṇawith an image of Bhīmasena in the middle, Hanumān on the left and Draupadī on the right. On the southern wall of the ground floor is an image of Sūrya (the Sun God). An open space on the first floor is used for recitations. The sanctum of the temple is also on the first floor. Inside the sanctum, one can find a standing terracotta image of Bhīmasena, who is wearing red garments, a crown and other jewelry. Bhīmasena appears to be dancing; as such, he is also called Khyāli Bhindyaḥ. A big stick on the right-hand side of Bhimasena is considered hisgadā(club), and is carried to Cyāsal during the Indrajātrā festival when ajhyālcāis exhibited. To the left of Bhīmasena, one can find Draupadī and a tiger. A bell donated in NS 778 hangs in front of the sanctum. An image of Nandī is attached to the southern wall, whilst one of Bhṛṅgī is attached to the northern wall. It is possible to circumambulate the sanctum of the temple. Outside, the temple's three pinnacles are topped with parasols. A metal banner (patāḥ) hangs down from the middle pinnacle to the latticed window of the first floor.Four Bhīmasenas are considered to be the four major Bhīmasena Temples of Lalitpur, namely, Juju Bhindyaḥ (the Kings' Bhīmasena) of Mangalbazar, Puṃ Bhindyaḥ (the artists' Bhīmasena) of Sundhara, Dhvākhā Bhindyaḥ (a Bhīmasena placed nearby a door) of Chāḥ Bāhāḥ and Kumhāḥ Bhindyaḥ (a Bhīmasena established by potters) of Cyāsal.  The name of this area, Bhindyaḥlāchi itself, is taken from the deity's name.
description_ne: ललितपुरमा रहेका भीमसेनमध्ये चारलाई मुख्य भीमसेन मानी पूजा गरिन्छ । ती हुन्– मंगलबजारमा रहेको जुजु भिन्द्य: (राजाको भीमसेन), सुन्धारामा रहेको पुं भिन्द्य: (चित्रकारहरूको भीमसेन), छा:बहालमा रहेको ध्वाखा भिन्द्य: (ढोकानिर रहेको भीमसेन) र च्यासलमा रहेको कुम्हा: भिन्द्य: (कुम्हालेहरूको भीमसेन) । कुम्हालेहरूले स्थापना गरेको भीमसेन हुनाले च्यासलमा रहेको भीमसेनलाई कुम्हा: भिन्द्य: भनिएको हो । भीमसेनको मन्दिर रहेकोले त्यस ठाउँको नाम नै भिन्द्य:लाछि रहन गएको हो । पूर्वाभिमुख यो मन्दिर दुई तलाको छ । मन्दिरको भुइँतला फल्चाको शैलीमा बनाइएको छ । प्रवेशद्वारको माथि काष्ठतोरण राखिएको छ । तोरणको मध्यभागमा भीमसेन, दायाँ हनुमान् र बायाँ द्रौपदी राखिएको छ । भुइँतलाको दक्षिणतिरको भित्तामा सूर्यको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरको पहिलो तलामा पूजाआजा र भजन गर्न खुल्ला ठाउँ बनाइएको छ । यसै तलामा छुट्टै कोठा बनाएर गर्भगृह स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकाको माथि राखिएको पित्तलको तोरणमा मध्यभागमा भीमसेन, बायाँ हनुमान् र दायाँ द्रौपदीको प्रतिमा छ । गर्भगृहभित्र जुँगा भएका मुकुट, कण्ठी, कुण्डल आदि आभूषण लगाएका रक्तवर्णका भीमसेनको माटोले बनेको प्रतिमा छ । नृत्य मुद्रामा रहेकाले यी भीमसेनलाई ख्यालि भिन्द्य: पनि भनिन्छ । भीमसेनको दायाँतिर एउटा ठूलो लौरो राखिएको छ । यस लौरोलाई भीमसेनको गदा भनिन्छ र प्रत्येक वर्ष इन्द्रजात्रामा च्यासलमा झ्याल्चा देखाउँदा यो गदा लाने चलन छ । भीमसेनको बायाँपट्टि बाघ र द्रौपदीको प्रतिमा छ । गर्भगृहको ठीक सामुन्ने नेसं ७७८ अंकित घण्टा झुण्ड्याइएको छ । दक्षिणतिरको भित्तामा नन्दी र उत्तरतिरको भित्तामा भृङ्गीको प्रतिमा राखिएका छन् । गर्भगृहलाई चारैतिरबाट प्रदक्षिणा गर्न मिल्ने गरी बनाइएको छ । पहिलो तलामा तामाको छाना राखिएको छ । छानामाथि बहीमा जस्तै फुचा बनाइएको छ । सबैभन्दा माथि तीनवटा गजुर राखी छत्र ओढाइएको छ । गजुरदेखि पहिलो तलाको छानासम्म लत्रिने गरी पता: राखिएको छ ।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick)

historical_events.event_description: Cikudhika Prajāpati, including 13 others from the Cavadaśa Guṭhī and Sukhuri Prajāpati - and ten others from the sameguṭhī- donated two golden finials to the temple.
Dhanamāsĩ (Dhanamāna Siṃha) Prajāpati donated land to light oil lamps and distributedsamayabajiat thephalcā.
This inscription is damaged in many places and therfore difficult to read. It mentions the donation of a golden pinnacle by Ragusiṃha Thakura in one place but the details are missing.

historical_events.event_name: Pavement of stone in front of Bhīmasena
historical_events.event_description: The stone in front of Bhīmasena was paved by Prajāpati Lakṣyasiṃha Thakura, Prajāpati Viṣṇusiṃha Thakura and Bhavadeva Thakura.
Local people widened the first floor of the god house by removing the window of the western side.
Gaumi Siṃha and others donated this bell to Bhīmasena. In this inscription Bhīmasena is called Mahāhindu Bhīmarājeśvara.
The temple was rebuilt by Lalitpur Metropolitan City, GIZ/UDLE - with the help of local people.

The earthquake of 2015 caused a crack to appear on the back of the Bhīmasena statue. The statue began to be refurbished in VS 2075, Āśvina 6. Artist Rajkumar Maharjan performed a worship at the Mhepi temple of Kathmandu and brought soil from the temple to repair this statue. The work ended with a special worship on VS 2075, Phālguna 1-3.
